project.name: Atlas
project.description: Rust and Slint UI framework exposing versioned design tokens, components, facades, and validation tooling.

dependency_policies.name: Rust
dependency_policies.managed_by: Slint 1.17.1 and the Atlas workspace MSRV

capabilities.name: Versioned Slint facades
capabilities.description: Provides SemVer-governed stable imports and explicitly evolving preview imports for Slint consumers.

capabilities.name: Design tokens and components
capabilities.description: Provides shared typography, color, geometry, motion, interaction, and application component contracts.

capabilities.name: Deterministic visual validation
capabilities.description: Maintains cross-platform compile gates and deterministic visual scenarios for consumer review.
